facts.text: StandaRotatorManager drives a Standa-branded motor controller, for example an 8SMC5 for a motorized rotation mount
The rotator's absolute position is in degrees
A relative rotator step is in degrees
The rotator widget displays the position in deg and the speed in mrpm
The speed the rotator widget passes on is in mrpm
StandaMotor is constructed with the controller device id, the libximc directory, steps_per_turn and microsteps_per_step
The upstream manager reads motorListIndex, ximcLibLocation, stepsPerTurn and microstepsPerStep from the setup and passes them to StandaMotor
The upstream class opens the controller through libximc and sets the default sync-in and sync-out settings after opening it
get_pos waits for the motor to stop and returns the angle in degrees from the controller's step and microstep position
dist_translate_inv converts steps and microsteps to degrees with steps_per_turn and microsteps_per_step
moveabs and moverel convert an angle in degrees to steps and microsteps and send command_move or command_movr
wait_for_stop sends command_wait_for_stop with an interval
stop_cont_rot sends command_sstp and start_cont_rot sends command_right
